labels.name: kind/more-info-needed
labels.rationale: The bug report is missing required sections: expected outcome, system information, Prometheus version, and configuration. Maintainers need these to reproduce the issue.

items.body:
To help reproduce and diagnose this issue, could you provide the following missing details?

- What did you expect to see?
- System information (OS, environment, etc.)
- Prometheus version
- Prometheus configuration file

This information will help maintainers understand and address the problem more effectively. Thank you!
